exposure: Care provider type (Certified Nurse-Midwives vs. physicians)
cohort: 136,848 TRICARE beneficiaries who gave birth during 2012-2014
finding: Low-risk women whose births were attended by CNMs had lower odds of several adverse birth outcomes and higher odds of vaginal birth, VBAC, and breastfeeding compared to women whose births were attended by physicians.
mod_finding: Low-risk women whose births were attended by Certified Nurse-Midwives had lower odds of a cesarean birth, induction/augmentation of labor, complications of birth, postpartum hemorrhage, endometritis, and preterm birth and higher odds of a vaginal birth, vaginal birth after cesarean, and breastfeeding than women whose births were attended by physicians.
